description: Galavant begins his attempt to reclaim Madalena and discovers that Richard, Isabella and the people around him have agendas that repeatedly derail the clean heroic story he imagined.

s01e01.description: After Madalena chooses King Richard’s wealth over him, Galavant sinks into despair until Princess Isabella recruits him to rescue her kingdom and gives him a chance to pursue Madalena again.

s01e02.description: Galavant enters a jousting tournament against Sir Jean Hamm to prove he still has heroic ability and earn travel money, while Richard asks Gareth to make him more intimidating.

s01e03.description: A stop in Sid’s hometown reveals he exaggerated his status and adventures, while Richard throws a grand ball in Valencia in a clumsy attempt to improve morale.

s01e04.description: Galavant, Isabella and Sid are captured by land-bound pirates and must stop bickering long enough to cooperate, while Richard tries another strategy to win Madalena’s affection.

s01e05.description: Galavant begins recognizing his feelings for Isabella as Richard’s confidence grows, only for Richard’s domineering older brother Kingsley to arrive and challenge his authority.

s01e06.description: Richard drinks a magician’s potion in search of self-understanding while Galavant tries to make sense of his shifting feelings between Madalena and Isabella.

s01e07.description: Richard challenges Kingsley to a duel but needs Galavant to fight as his champion, finally giving Galavant the straightforward heroic task he has been craving.

s01e08.description: Galavant’s allies hatch a plan to kill Kingsley before the duel, while competing loyalties and Richard’s threatened rule drive the season toward an unstable resolution.
